name: The Ancient Egg
summary: In Tanaris, Yeh'kinya seeks the ancient egg named in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru. It comes from the age of troll empires, and he wants you to bring it from Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Relic of Troll Empires
sections.body: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru tells of an ancient egg from the age when trolls ruled vast empires. Its power can contain Hakkar's essence. Yeh'kinya believes it may be the only way to guard the world from his evil.

sections.title: Behind the Amphitheater
sections.body: Yeh'kinya asks you to bring the egg to Tanaris. Tales place it deep inside Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater atop the city. Great forces stir, and Yeh'kinya fears time is running short.

faq.answer: A relic from the age when trolls ruled vast empires, told of in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru. Its power can hold Hakkar's essence.

faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want the egg?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya believes the egg may be the only way to guard the world from Hakkar's evil.
Tales place the egg deep inside Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater atop the city.

faq.q: Who wants the egg brought to them?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya waits in Tanaris and wants you to bring the ancient egg there.
